popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Names Endeis as Aeacus' wife and mother of Peleus and Telamon — the Aeacid matriarch whose household later fractures over Phocus.

popCulture.title: Endeis
popCulture.description: First wife of Aeacus of Aegina; mother of Peleus and Telamon in the Aeacid stem.
